Our story

A family trading house built on patience and salt.

In 2024, Gimm’s was a single delivery van carrying Soy Sauce, Ketchup, Oyster, Chami, Patis, and Vinegar.

Today those roads run to nineteen condiment lines, from the sari-sari store on the corner to the wet market stall, the cafeteria kitchen, the eatery, the food stall, and the supermarket shelf.

The reach has grown. The ingredients haven’t changed. We still buy the same high-quality ingredients we started with.

How we choose what we carry

01

Sourced at origin

We visit every fermenter and press we buy from: the Ilocos vinegar makers, the Pangasinan patis vats, the Bicol chili growers. We go to find inspiration for the taste we will be making.

02

Tested in real kitchens

No product joins the catalogue on a promise. Our partner chefs cook with it through a full month of service first.

03

Held to one standard

Before any pallet leaves the warehouse, batch samples are checked for acidity, salinity, and colour. Every bottle has to pass the same test.
